claims.text: Cut Lindqvist API p95 latency from 800ms to 320ms with Redis caching

turns.q: Tell me about the Lindqvist latency improvement.
turns.text: I added a Redis read-through cache on the Lindqvist product endpoint. In the load test p95 went from 800ms to 320ms, and I checked the cache hit rate was 87 percent before shipping.

observations.summary: Redis read-through cache with measured p95 change supports the latency claim.

turns.q: How did you handle cache invalidation?
turns.text: Writes to a Lindqvist product publish an event that deletes the key, and I set a five minute TTL as a safety net. I tested stale reads with a script that updates then immediately reads.

observations.summary: Event-driven key deletion with TTL adds depth to the Redis caching claim.
